en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large ornate fountain in the center of a public square. The fountain features multiple sculpted figures around a circular basin, with a prominent statue on top. Surrounding the square are neoclassical buildings; on the right a domed building with an arched façade is visible. The scene is labeled in Greek and French at the bottom margin, identifying the location as Patras and Place Georges I.
